The Caravan and Motorhome Club
The Caravan and Motorhome Club is delighted to announce that, following close collaboration with the award-winning Park Cliffe Camping and Caravan Estate, it will take over the operation of the campsite under a long-term lease agreement. The Club looks forward to its team bringing expertise and commitment to deliver memorable stays as the campsite enters a new chapter as Park Cliffe Windermere Camping and Caravan Park.
Find out more
Award winning holiday park in the heart of The Lake District
Located 3 miles from Bowness-on-Windermere, Park Cliffe Windermere Camping and Caravan Park offers a peaceful, tranquil retreat from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, while the attractions of Bowness are just a 5-minute bus ride away.
Whether your stay is in a tourer, tent, caravan, one of our rather fabulous camping pods, luxury static caravan or lodge, you’ll receive a warm welcome from our friendly staff.
The park is in a world of its own with absolutely stunning views over lake Windermere and the fells and mountains beyond - Lake District camping at its best!
Discover more
Come in and explore...
One of the best Lake District Camping & Caravan Parks
Park Cliffe boasts beautiful surroundings enabling a peaceful and relaxing stay.
An abundance of wildlife such as squirrels, roe and red deer, foxes and birds surround us. Such are our environmental credentials that the late TV botanist David Bellamy was an especially big fan of Park Cliffe. So much so that he has presented us with his prestigious Gold Conservation Award for our work in protecting the natural environment!
Our modern and well equipped accommodation is coupled with a range of modern amenities to ensure a comfortable stay. These include a bar and the River Box Kitchen (seasonal hours apply), games room, well-stocked shop , children s adventure playground , private bathrooms for hire and free park wide Wi-Fi .
Our accommodation comprises of touring and camping pitches,  static caravans for hire  and privately owned holiday home caravans and lodges. We also offer Lake District glamping options with our range of   camping pods and a shepherd s hut .
Explore the accommodation we have an offer using the links below, you can also check our availability online or give us a call on 015395 31344 to book your stay.

Ways to stay
Your world away...
Park Cliffe boasts beautiful surroundings enabling a peaceful and relaxing stay.
Why us...
Award winning
Best Family Campsite in North West England 2025 | Cumbria Tourism Camping, Glamping and Holiday Park of the Year 2025 | Tripadvisor Travellers Choice Award 2024 | Sustainability Award North West Winner 2024 | Cumbria in Bloom Gold Award 2024 | In-Cumbria Business Best Family Business Winner 2023 | In-Cumbria Green/Ethical Business of the Year 2023
Unique location
Park Cliffe occupies an idyllic Lake District location with wonderful views of Windermere and the surrounding fells. We are just 3 miles from Bowness-on-Windermere - a short 5-minute bus ride away - where you can enjoy scenic lake cruises and peruse independent shops. Sample some of the best produce from across the region in one of the tasty pubs, cafes, or restaurants.
Child friendly
Younger members of the family will love their stay at Park Cliffe! We are a family friendly caravan and camping park and have some great facilities to keep kids entertained. Our outdoor play area features a range of play equipment, perfect for burning off energy and making new friends. We also have an indoor games room with table football, air hockey and games machines.

Choose your perfect holiday accommodation at Park Cliffe
Enjoy caravan, camping and glamping accommodation in the Lake District at Park Cliffe holiday park. You'll experience the same warm welcome and first class facilities whichever way you stay with us.
Camping
Enjoy far reaching views over Lake Windermere during a camping trip at Park Cliffe. Sit back, relax and admire the beauty of the regions largest lake from our spacious tent pitches. Our enviable position on the lake's eastern side means you can watch the sun set below the fells at the end of a busy day. Our Lake District campsite is an excellent choice for families wanting to explore the area and boasts a range of on site facilities for a comfortable stay.
Take a look
Touring and Motorhomes
Park Cliffe is the ideal choice for a touring caravan or motorhome holiday in the Lake District. Set within the bounds of the National Park, our caravan park is perfectly positioned to enjoy day trips to the Lake Districts best loved sights. All of our pitches are hardstanding with spacious surrounds and landscaping. From the majority of our touring pitches you can enjoy views of Moor How, a small hill behind the park offering spectacular views of the surrounding fells.
Take a look
Camping Pods
Our heated and sheep-wool insulated wooden camping pods are perfect for a Lake District getaway. Glamping in The Lake District is a brilliant way to stay in the great outdoors, without the hassle of pitching up a tent. We have 5 different types of camping pod on the park, depending on the needs of your group. Our couples pods are ideal for a romantic getaway and we even have dog friendly pods so you can bring your four legged friend!
Take a look
Static Caravans
We have a range of modern and well-equipped caravan holiday homes available for hire at Park Cliffe camping and caravan park. All of our static caravans are let fully furnished, containing everything you will need for a comfortable and enjoyable stay. Relax on your private decking as you enjoy a morning coffee. Our self-catering caravan holiday homes are within easy reach of all the parks amenities. Dog friendly options are available.
Take a look
The Shepherd Hut
Our hand crafted shepherds hut is the an ideal choice for couples seeking a romantic glamping holiday in the Lake District National Park. Tastefully decorated with plush soft furnishings and a characterful interior, it's the perfect home away from home. With a double bed, table, sofa and underfloor heating for your comfort, you will be warm and cosy regardless of weather. There is a small balcony area with views over the stream.
Take a look
Holiday Home Ownerhip
Set in peaceful surroundings, with stunning views of mountains and Lake Windermere, it's not difficult to see why Park Cliffe is considered one of the best holiday parks in the Lake District.
If you want your own little piece of Park Cliffe why not consider becoming a holiday home owner at our 5 star park. We have a range of caravan holiday homes and timber lodges for sale, each finished to the same high standard and located in a quiet area of the park.
Take a look
The Three Lakes Tour
Ullswater, Derwentwater and Lake Windermere are all combined in this three-night lake-lovers break which has been created by ourselves and our friends at The Quiet Site and Castlerigg Hall. The 3 Lakes Tour is on offer to small/medium campervan owners, those bringing a tent or hiring a camping pod. Spend each night at a different site as you explore the best sights and attractions within the Lake District national park.
Take a look
PodnPedal
* Currently suspended * Three of the Lake District’s best campsites have joined forces to offer a new sustainable cycling holiday experience. Spend two days cycling through some of the best countryside the UK has to offer, coupled with three nights staying in Camping Pods overlooking three different lakes. Each of the parks offer modern and well maintained facilities, so you can rest and relax after a day on the bike.

FAQs | Lake District Camping & Caravanning | Park Cliffe
FAQs
Use the categories below to view our frequently asked questions. If you cannot find an answer within these areas, you can use our online form to contact us or call or email.
Our Most Frequently Asked Questions
I’m not a member of the Caravan and Motorhome Club. Can I still stay at Park Cliffe?
Absolutely! We are delighted to welcome everyone to Park Cliffe. While the Caravan and Motorhome Club has taken over the operation of the campsite, the gates remain open to members and non-members alike, just as they have always been.
Further Info
What changes are you making to Park Cliffe?
Our priority is to preserve what makes Park Cliffe so special and to maintain the same high standards you’ve come to expect.
Further Info
What happens if I have a Seasonal Pitch booked?
If you've already booked a seasonal pitch for 2026, nothing changes and your booking remains under the same terms as when you made the booking.
Further Info
What happens if I have an existing booking for 2026?
Your existing booking, including the terms under which it was made, will remain unchanged.

Are BBQ’s allowed?
Yes BBQs are fine, but must be raised off the grass. Stands are available in reception if required for a £5 returnable deposit.
Further Info
Are campfires allowed?
Sorry but no open fires are permitted at Park Cliffe Caravan and Camping Park. BBQs are fine, but must be raised off the grass.
Further Info
Are dogs allowed in the pods?
Yes, dogs are welcome to stay in all our pods except our Family Vista...
Further Info
Are pets allowed in the shepherd hut?
Unfortunately, we’re unable to accept pets in the Shepherd’s Hut.
Further Info
Are pets allowed?
Dogs are allowed in certain static caravans (max 2)  at an extra charge of...
Further Info
Are the static caravans child friendly?
Each of our caravan holiday homes has its own enclosed deck, so children can...
Further Info
Are there fish in Consiton?
Yes, there are fish in Coniston and it’s a popular with anglers. Species include rainbow trout, brown trout and pike.
Further Info
Are there many shops in Keswick?
This traditional market town has a wide range of local shops and boutiques selling a wide range of products such as woollen jumpers, cakes, gifts, and art.
Further Info
Are there sockets available for my hair straighteners?
Yes there are plug sockets are available in the shower blocks. These are suitable...
Further Info
Are you a camping or caravan park?
We do accommodate campers and tourers. We have private owners too with 46 holiday caravans and 9 holiday lodges but that section of the park is completely separate.
Further Info
Can I book a private bathroom?
Our private bathrooms are accessed via stairs above our facility block.  They can be booked for exclusive use at £15/nt.
Further Info
Can I charge my electric car?
We have 2 x 7kw electric car charging points in the main car park. Tokens at £3.50 for an hour, purchase from reception.
Further Info
Can I cycle around Rydal Water?
Yes, there are plenty of cycling trails around Rydal water; however, these trails are not for the faint-hearted!
Further Info
Can I fish on Bassenthwaite Lake?
Yes, you can fish on Bassenthwaite Lake. It’s a lovely place to spend the day.
Further Info
Can I fish on Haweswater Reservoir?
Yes! Fly fishing on Haweswater Reservoir is popular among those who visit!
Further Info
Can I freeze my ice packs on site?
Ice packs can be frozen in reception, and we have frozen blocks that can be borrowed whilst yours are freezing down. No charge for this service.
Further Info
Can I kayak on Coniston Water?
Yes, kayaking and canoeing are both permitted on Coniston. The picturesque lake is ideal for beginners as well as experienced kayakers.
Further Info
Can I kayak on Rydal Water?
We’re afraid not. Canoes, kayaks, paddleboards or boats of any kind are not permitted on the water.
Further Info
Can I launch my boat on Coniston?
Yes, it is possible to launch your own boat at Coniston. The most convenient place is at Coniston Boating Centre.
Further Info
Can I move permanently into my caravan holiday home?
No, you cannot live in your holiday home. You are restricted to using it for holiday or recreational purposes only.
Further Info
Can I paddleboard on Bassenthwaite?
Yes, Bassenthwaite is a wonderful place to go paddleboarding in the Lake District.
Further Info
Can I paddleboard, canoe or kayak at Haweswater Reservoir?
SUP Paddleboarding, Kayaking and Canoeing are unfortunately not allowed in Haweswater Reservoir because it supplies drinking water to much of the north west.
Further Info
Can I park my car next to the Shepherds hut?
Yes, there is allocated parking for 1 car next to the Shepherds Hut. If you are bringing more than one car, the second should be parked in the car park next to reception. Any commercial vehicles must be parked in the car park.
